lines.t: I've seen love that fades away
burns for a moment then it breaks leaves you reaching in the dark with empty hands to hold
i've walked on ground that couldn't last felt it slipping way too fast every promise
to swear every heart grows cold but you are not like anything i've known you don't change
and you don't let me go
There is no love like yours
You don't shift with every passing wind
Don't grow distant, don't give in
You are steady, you are sure
There's no line I have to walk for you
What you give, you give in full
You'll remain when everything else ends
No fear, no hesitation, you outlast it all
When everything is breaking, you are standing strong
There is no love like yours, no love like yours
Higher than the heavens, deeper than the sea
Nothing could contain it, nothing takes it from me
Faithful through the ages, wholly set apart
You have always been exactly who you are
There is no love like yours
